span.p:
SwiftUI is inherently declarative: views describe what to render
based on state. MVVM separates presentation logic from
UI declaration, making each independently testable.
ViewModels hold form state, validation, loading flags, and API calls.
Views remain pure UI — they bind to VM properties via @Bindable
and trigger actions via VM methods. Models are plain Codable structs.
